archive_entries_from_jump.detail: gsk3b fc33df003b91 and celecoxib a177033588c6, both surviving rounds 1-14 with provenance.planner_channel == joint_dependency_region_jump. I sampled 7 of 15 rounds and concluded zero; the correct figure is 2 of 2,448.

jump_proposals_total.detail: I read the ROUND-13 channel counters (319/340/346). The true final-round totals are 351/362/378 = 1,091. Snapshot history is CUMULATIVE across rounds, so the final round alone is the complete record.

CORRECTIONS_FROM_THE_FUNNEL_AUDIT.what_does_not_change: The attribution conclusion stands and is strengthened: 2 archive entries of 2,448 and 3 production executions of 1,091 proposals still means the realizer contributed essentially nothing to the scored gains, which came from the pooled channels. VERDICT REMAINS REVISE, NOT PROMOTE.

ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.integration_point_named_no_redesign: PmoPopulationController._generate_jump_pool (pmo_population_controller.py:262-) pairs parent_schedule[attempt % len] with plans[(plan_offset + attempt) % len] -- indexed INDEPENDENTLY, so plan scale is never conditioned on parent support. `static_first_step_feasible` plus a root `propagate` are pinned zero-search certificates costing ~0.2 ms that would have rejected 72% of attempts before any search.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.mechanism: Offline, teacher-scale plans were bound to teacher-sized parents (median 24 heavy atoms). In production the SAME plans are bound to archive parents of attempt-weighted median 9. A median-28-primitive plan demanding median 6 preexisting-atom deletions cannot be realized on a 9-atom parent, so proven_incompatible is the CORRECT answer, not a search failure.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.realizer_successes_carry_the_falsifier_s: All 9 production completions are retained 1.000, median 14 primitives, 0 at teacher scale, 0 in the teacher band -- against the offline comparator of median 31 at retained 0.630. The repair's measured benefit does not appear on production parents at all, because there is nothing to remove from a 9-atom parent.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.second_order_defect: _generate_jump_pool passes seconds_cap=min(PRODUCTION_SECONDS_CAP, wall_seconds - elapsed), so late attempts in a batch get a cap far below 20 s. At the honest cap the same pairs yield 9 realizations against production's 3. Real and separable, but 9/1091 is still 0.82% and does not change the verdict.

the_axis_is_parent_SIZE_and_both_populat.note: The parents are not different molecules, they are SMALLER ones.

ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.the_interaction_not_the_archive: All three channels see the same parents (under-10 share 52.6% / 45.5% / 53.8%), and shallow and structured execute 100% of their proposals there. The jump lane executes 0.3%. Execution by parent size: 0/587 under 10, 0/159 at 10-19, 3/218 at 20-29.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.the_smoking_gun: production_init contains ZERO parents under 15 heavy atoms; the archive has 92 of 226 under 10 -- literal C, N, Br, Cl, [SH4] entries. `Br` received 42 jump attempts. 587 of 1,091 attempts (53.8%) were aimed at parents under 10 heavy atoms.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.verdict: A -- the realizer is correct; the jump PROPOSER is mis-scaled for the production parent population
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.why_not_B: Disabling propagate and raising the budget ~300x (20,000 nodes / 60 s) found a realization in 0 of the 1,072 pairs the exact arm called incompatible -- ZERO unsound prunes at 45x the scale of the earlier witness gate. Only 1.1% hit a budget cap.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.why_not_C_and_this_is_the_important_one: The beam binds MORE (13 pairs vs 9) but binds WRONG: only 9 of its 31 bindings realize the plan's declared component_count, and 31/31 are purely additive at retained_fraction 1.000, median 16 primitives -- EXACTLY the predeclared falsifier. It bound 0 of the 740 teacher-scale attempts. 'The beam is better' is refuted on semantics.
ROOT_CAUSE_VERDICT.why_not_D: 3 production executions -> 3 selected for oracle -> 2 charged and scored -> 1 improved its parent (+0.040).

archive_channel_census.note: 2 of 2,448 archived entries came from the jump lane (gsk3b fc33df003b91, celecoxib a177033588c6); every other entry came from the pooled channels. CORRECTED from 0 -- the first pass sampled 7 of 15 rounds.

headline: All three tasks improved on best score at matched 250-call budget, and NONE of it is attributable to the realization repair under test. The repaired binder lives in the jump lane; the jump lane produced 3 executions and 2 archive entries across 1,091 proposals.
next_test_zero_oracle: Determine why 95%+ of jump bindings are rejected in production while the same realizer completed 5 of 24 teacher-scale witness pairs offline. Candidates: the production parent population differs from the witness stratum; the 20s per-attempt cap truncates the productive tail in-lane; or plan latents at >=29 primitives (45 of 95) never bind on production parents at all.
the_opportunity_cost: The jump lane made MORE proposals than shallow (319 vs 281 on gsk3b) while returning 1 execution against 211. It consumes roughly a third of the proposal allocation and returns ~2% of the improvement mass. The integration agent flagged the realizer's throughput cost (~6.5 attempts per lane instead of up to 32) as a RISK; it is now measured as a cost to the channels that do work.
what_is_NOT_claimed: that the realization repair improves PMO scores
that v2 should be promoted to 1,000 calls
that the gsk3b +0.08 is anything other than run-to-run variance in the pooled channels
why_this_was_caught: The contract predeclared that realized program scale and retained fraction are read BEFORE bind rate, with the falsifier 'programs at retained ~1.000 with median ~16 primitives mean the repair did not help REGARDLESS of bind rate'. Without that read order, 'PMO-v2 improves all three tasks, gsk3b +38%' would have been reported as the realizer working.
worse_than_the_beam_it_replaced: v1's autopsy measured the jump lane at 5 eligible of 232 proposals (2.2%). v2's realizer runs at ~0.3%. So in PRODUCTION the exact realizer is no better, and plausibly worse, than the width-4 beam it replaced -- despite being measurably BETTER offline (5 teacher-scale completions vs the beam's 0, median 31 primitives at retained 0.630). Explaining that offline/production gap is the prerequisite for any redesign.
